description: Create task from a template. Requires: (template_id or template_name) + (list_id or list_name). Optional: task_name to override the default template task name.

list_id.description: List ID to create the task in.

task_name.description: Override the default task name from the template.

team_id.description: The ClickUp Team ID or Workspace Name to use. If provided, the server will switch to this workspace for this and subsequent requests in the current session.

name: create_task_from_template
